title: 32nd Annual UPUA National Convention & Cultural Gala
venueName: Hilton Anatole Luxury Hotel & Convention Center
summary: The premier annual convention of Urhobo Progress Union America bringing together delegates, leaders, royal fathers, and youth from across North America for cultural celebration and strategic governance.
contactPerson: Convention Planning Committee: Chief Samuel Ogaga & Chief Godwin Ikporo
highlights: Keynote addresses by prominent Urhobo royal fathers and international diplomats
Executive Council and Board of Trustees legislative sessions
UPUAYA Diaspora Youth Congress, STEM showcase, and networking summit
Grand National Cultural Banquet, traditional regalia procession, and awards gala
description: Welcome to the 32nd Annual National Convention of the Urhobo Progress Union America (UPUA), hosted this year in the dynamic metropolitan center of Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas! Join thousands of Urhobo sons, daughters, traditional rulers, and esteemed friends for four unforgettable days of brotherhood, cultural splendor, economic empowerment, and fellowship.

title: UPUAYA North America Youth Leadership & Tech Symposium
address: Live Streamed Across All 16 Chapter Hubs
summary: Interactive career acceleration, AI literacy, and cultural leadership summit organized by the UPUAYA National Youth Executive Committee.
pricing: Free for Registered Youth Members (RSVP Required)
highlights: Tech industry keynote: AI Career Pathways for Urhobo Diaspora Youth
Interactive breakout rooms: Resume reviews, mentorship matching
Panel: Preserving cultural identity while thriving in corporate America
description: The Urhobo Progress Union America Youth Association (UPUAYA) invites college students, young professionals, and creatives across the diaspora to an inspiring interactive symposium focused on technology, career elevation, and community impact.

title: Emergency Humanitarian Relief Fundraiser Banquet
summary: Special national fundraising dinner dedicated to providing food, medical aid, and shelter reconstruction for displaced Okuama families.
contactPerson: Chief Godspower Oniovosa & UPA Houston Host Committee
highlights: Direct video updates and testimonials from ground relief coordinators
Silent auction of fine Urhobo art and commemorative coral regalia
100% of proceeds channeled to verified relief distribution in Urhoboland
description: Standing shoulder to shoulder with our brothers and sisters in their hour of greatest need, UPUA convenes an emergency benefit banquet in Houston to mobilize crucial humanitarian assistance for displaced families.

title: Board of Trustees & Chapter Presidents National Council
venueName: Georgia World Congress Center Executive Suite
address: 285 Andrew Young Intl Blvd NW, Atlanta, GA 30313
summary: Statutory bi-annual convocation of the Board of Trustees and Chapter Presidents to ratify annual budgets and constitutional amendments.
highlights: Presentation of 2025–2026 audited financial statements by National Treasurer
Deliberation on permanent UPUA National Secretariat Acquisition
Review of convention host bids for 2027 and 2028
description: The leadership convocation gathers BOT members and chapter leaders to evaluate the union's progress, conduct institutional audits, and steer long-term organizational strategy.
